intro.heading: Sameer Khan - Full-Stack Software Engineer
intro.welcome: Welcome to my little piece of the internet. I'm the Co-Founder of agentShop — the commerce intelligence layer that turns AI conversations into consultative sales. I'm a Full-Stack Software Engineer based in San Francisco, specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and AI/ML integration.
intro.imageCaption: dinner with Stanford's next generation of entrepreneurs!
intro.aboutMeText: I'm the Co-Founder of agentShop, helping brands show up where AI is deciding what customers buy. Before that, I evaluated 500+ startups as a Portfolio Tech Analyst at MARL Accelerator, built AI-powered bookkeeping at PomJuice, and conducted research in explainable AI for brain tumor diagnosis at Sonoma State University, where I graduated with honors.
intro.frontendSkills: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML/CSS
intro.aimlSkills: TensorFlow, PyTorch, LLM Integration, Prompt Engineering
intro.whatIWriteText: On my technical blog, I share comprehensive reviews of frontier AI models like GPT-5, Claude Opus, and DeepSeek, along with React tutorials, TypeScript guides, and developer tools comparisons. I believe in learning in public and sharing knowledge with the developer community.
intro.currentFocusText: I'm currently building agentShop — the commerce intelligence layer that helps brands own the AI shelf across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. When I'm not building, you can find me exploring the Bay Area, writing about AI on my blog, or diving deep into the latest tech trends.
intro.letsConnectText: I'm always interested in connecting with fellow developers, discussing new technologies, or exploring collaboration opportunities. Feel free to reach out through any of the channels below!
